latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Highlight Editor Unlimited — Extract and Export Video Highlights.

- Upload raw MP4, MOV, AVI, or WebM videos (up to 500MB) and extract short highlight reels in 1080p MP4 format.
- Works for sports creators, vloggers, and event videographers; highlights generation is done in the cloud and takes 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic token management: supports both environment-based and anonymous authentication for seamless onboarding.
- Guides users to upload, request highlight extraction, manage credits, and export results with simple instructions.
- Robust error handling and clear feedback on file types, credit status, and export limits.
- Supports batching, iterative editing, and timeline previews; summarize changes if edits return no direct response.
